hero.headline: Where Heritage Meets Living
hero.subheadline: Rare large-format plotted estates (11,000 sq.ft onwards) in the monsoon-rich valley of Ghavar, near Bhor. Encircled by the legendary Maratha forts of Rajgad & Torna, just 40 minutes from Pune.
highlightPills: 7 Fruit Plants Per Plot with Smart Drip
40 Mins from Pune • 20 Mins from Nasrapur

agroServices.title: 7 Fruit Plants Per Plot
agroServices.desc: Every plot comes pre-planted with 7 thriving fruit plants including Kesar Mango, Rajapuri Mango, Chiku, Jackfruit, and Malaysian Green Dwarf Coconut.

agroServices.title: Smart Israeli Drip Irrigation
agroServices.desc: Automated drip lines engineered for optimal water distribution, linked to deep borewells ensuring green orchards year-round.

agroServices.title: Separate Water Supply System
agroServices.desc: Dedicated independent water pipelines and natural storage reservoir guaranteeing abundant fresh water for every farmstead.

agroServices.title: Dedicated Transformer Power
agroServices.desc: High-capacity dedicated electrical transformer infrastructure installed exclusively for the OVI FARMS community.

amenities.title: Centerpiece Infinity Pool
amenities.desc: Edge-less infinity swimming pool overlooking the lush Sahyadri valley with cascading waterfall spillover and poolside leisure deck.

amenities.title: The Countryside Clubhouse
amenities.desc: Architectural masterpiece set against the Sahyadri backdrop featuring indoor leisure lounges, entertaining decks, and private club membership.

amenities.title: Indoor Games & Billiards Lounge
amenities.desc: Pool table, carrom board, air hockey, table tennis, and a dedicated PlayStation gaming zone for friends and family.

amenities.title: Milky Way Stargazing Deck
amenities.desc: Telescope observation deck positioned in the pure pollution-free night skies of Ghavar for breathtaking celestial viewing.

amenities.title: Sunken Barbecue & Dining Terrace
amenities.desc: Illuminated poolside sunken lounge with built-in barbecue station for golden-hour gatherings and outdoor celebrations.

amenities.title: Multi-Sport Courts & Bird Machaan
amenities.desc: Regulation basketball and volleyball courts, pickleball zone, children’s adventure play area, and elevated Machaan for bird watching.

infrastructure.title: Grand Landmark Entrance Archway
infrastructure.desc: Imposing entrance gate with natural stone, wood accents, 24/7 manned security cabin, and CCTV perimeter monitoring.

infrastructure.title: Wide Concrete Internal Roads
infrastructure.desc: Durable, high-grade concrete avenue roads with curbside plantations connecting each plot seamlessly to the main highway.

infrastructure.title: Clear Boundary Pegging & Fencing
infrastructure.desc: Every plot is cleanly surveyed, registered, pegged, and enclosed with live green bio-hedges and boundary fencing.

infrastructure.title: Engineered Storm Drainage
infrastructure.desc: Heavy-duty monsoon drainage channels designed specifically for Sahyadri rainfall, preventing water-logging and soil erosion.
